name: Progress
description: Shows how far along a task is, as one thin bar.

value.description: Current value, between min and max. Null for work not yet counted.

tone.description: Fill colour. accent is the selection colour of work in progress; neutral is a meter whose maximum is not a verdict; warning and danger carry a quota near or over its limit. A full bar is never a success.

label.description: Label text above the progress bar

showValue.description: Show the value beside the label

formatValue.description: Custom formatter for displayed progress value

when: How much of a form is filled in
Waits where you know the duration
whenNot: You cannot say how long — use Loading
Status with no number — use Badge
guidelines: Pass a value when you know the percentage; pass null when you do not
Add a label whenever the bar alone leaves the purpose unclear
warning and danger carry state, not decoration; a finished task says so in words, not in green
tone="neutral" with role="meter" for a magnitude where full is not success
Values outside min and max are clamped before display
Pass aria-valuetext and aria-label to localise what a screen reader hears
accessibility: role="meter" is accepted for scalar readings inside a known range
The label is tied to the bar
Work not yet counted reports aria-busy and the value text "Loading"; under reduced motion it holds still at half strength

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Determinate bar with its percentage spelled out.

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: Colour carries state only: work in progress, a quota running out, a quota spent.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="md">
  <Progress value={75} label="Processing" showValue />
  <Progress value={82} tone="warning" label="Storage nearly full" showValue />
  <Progress value={100} tone="danger" label="Storage full" showValue />
</Stack>

examples.name: Meter
examples.description: A reading where hitting the top is not a win.
examples.code:
<Progress
  value={42}
  tone="neutral"
  role="meter"
  label="Seats used"
  showValue
/>

examples.name: Indeterminate
examples.description: value={null}: a short run travels the track until the work is counted.

relations.note: Use Badge for status without percentage
Use Loading when there is no bar to fill

propsSummary: value: number|null - progress value (null while not yet counted)
Determinate display values are clamped (and invalid min/max ranges render as 0%)
